objective: General-purpose stiff/oscillatory ODE with derivative-free-first structure-aware adaptation and selection

tasks.title: Keep implicit controller and workspace across accepted windows
actions: Introduce a persistent RODAS tenure with exact model/provider/norm/chart epoch binding.
Carry accepted controller state and bounded workspaces; invalidate numerical caches after incompatible state/operator changes.
Reuse only mathematically identical factorizations or separately bounded approximate operators.
acceptance: Compare uninterrupted and windowed output at identical requested physical observations.
Keep fatal/attempt-budget and replay ownership contracts.
Reduce setup overhead at common physical accuracy cap, including transition cost; count RHS/JVP/factor/solve separately.
tasks.routing: workhorse implementation; Astra ultra only for unresolved reuse correctness
tasks.risk: Stale operator or controller after a change of provider/chart; mutable side effects must not enter replay.

tasks.title: Cache settled causal prefixes and allocate precision by output influence
actions: Skip RHS recomputation only for stages whose causal predecessors are unchanged bitwise under deterministic pure callbacks.
Cache original-target interval values separately from candidate residual subtraction.
Use adjoint seed allowances; evaluate cost-weighted allocation after measuring per-stage refinement costs.
acceptance: Bitwise stage root and original-target residual parity against full-round baseline under fixed environment.
Epoch/state/h/provider changes invalidate all affected prefix caches.
Compare candidate+verification+cache costs against causal-forward, strongest reused direct method, and full-round iteration.
For expensive real RHS only, evaluate one stage parallel split with actual wall time.
tasks.routing: Astra ultra for domain/rounding proof; workhorse code; low-cost prescribed runs
tasks.risk: A cached target can remain valid while the candidate residual must change; side-effectful callbacks are ineligible.

tasks.title: Register derivative-free structures under one physical error contract
actions: Register declared chart/quotient/Fourier/Laguerre/causal providers with applicability, original-state reconstruction and error transport.
Use h-dependent eta(h) and valid inverse/Lipschitz bounds to screen inner solvers before costly probes.
Permit JVP/AD only under explicit authority and observed inadequacy of qualified derivative-free alternatives.
Preserve non-equivariant, noncommuting, near-pole and alias controls.
Separate capability discovery from route validation: an unavailable implicit challenger must be excluded without rejecting an otherwise admissible explicit solve.
acceptance: No stale physical norm/provider identity reuse.
Full-state output errors and reconstruction/phase uncertainty at requested observation grid.
Unsupported structure declines before callbacks; no guessed algebraic closure.
Positive same-cap total-cost evidence against strongest applicable fallback.
RHS-only valid problems remain solvable when an optional implicit challenger is unavailable; derivative permission alone never manufactures a provider.
tasks.routing: focused Astra ultra plus research tools for new hypotheses; routine workhorse implementation

tasks.title: Bound exploration spending and calibrate actual future cost
actions: Pre-reserve a valid worst-case probe cost before entering it; charge failures and return-side comparators.
Implement prefix credit bound Cprobe <= B0 + epsilon*Cproductive in a declared unit.
Calibrate RHS/JVP/factor/solve scores to measured window costs; retain independent accuracy qualification.
Keep previous-window rate only as a cheap return trigger; study false-negative suppression by drift/expiry.
Assess small-budget endpoint utilization separately from future method adoption.
acceptance: Exact prefix accounting under exhausted budgets, fatal callbacks and incomplete comparisons.
No economic switch from unmatched windows.
Untuned transition holdouts with paired source/build/host/physical output.
Record unproductive probes, wrong committed switches and whole-run overhead as separate metrics.
tasks.routing: Astra ultra only for bounded-credit proof; workhorse code; Luna low measurements

tasks.title: Extend physical error and domain contracts to continuous general outputs
actions: Translate time-dependent/nonlinear lift errors and phase uncertainty to full physical state.
Integrate stage-domain and accepted-only callback contracts reused from separate D2-D5 research branch through narrow interfaces.
Specify event, dense-output, mass-matrix eligibility independently of endpoint automatic selection.
acceptance: Observe full-state errors on time grid, not only endpoint or amplitude.
No out-of-domain stage callback or silently clipped physical state.
Recompute only dependencies affected by changed norm/chart/closure.
tasks.routing: Astra ultra precise math audit; workhorse implementation

tasks.title: Use measured execution selection for actual grid/data/stage work
actions: Bind real grid callback with explicit dimension/mesh/chart/method/work identity.
Choose one relevant parallel partition against serial and account pool/setup/calibration/verification.
Exercise abrupt and smooth cost drift, nested execution and late model changes without hidden replay.
acceptance: Ordered physical output parity and same accuracy scope.
Calibration-inclusive total cost and heldout decisions, separate startup.
A gain on ensembles is never reused as a stage/data speed claim.

tasks.title: Source-locked selection evaluation on local raw evidence
actions: Preserve local originals and bind source/binary/reference hashes.
Selected route plus one relevant same-checkpoint alternative; keep tuning and unseen evaluation windows separate.
External controls restricted to VODE/DVODE, Diffsol and Julia when a broader qualification campaign is justified.
Use one thread first on small-host workloads; no NCP or full method-by-thread Cartesian sweep.
acceptance: Failures/timeouts and inaccurate alternatives remain separate from comparable cost observations.
All probe/transition/setup costs counted once.
Return diagnosis for any faster qualified alternative instead of just plotting a ranking.
tasks.routing: Luna low or available low-cost mode

tasks.title: Qualify release scope from reproduced robustness and accuracy evidence
actions: Publish scoped capabilities and unsupported automatic features.
Run changed-dependency tests and predeclared robustness holdouts; reuse unchanged prior evidence.
Update human review, machine decisions and exact publication/source identities.
acceptance: No broad production promotion from stage pilot or synthetic timing alone.
Independent material findings closed with actual evidence.
Ship opt-in features only at their demonstrated scope.
tasks.routing: low-cost synthesis; one focused independent audit

routing.default: Luna low or actual available low-cost executor for fixed parsing/testing; workhorse for code
routing.precision_only: Astra ultra with physmath/SciSpace/Exa/Wolfram when a specific unresolved research question merits it
routing.availability: Verify available runtime; never claim an unavailable model or create external credentials
